changes: First release: KIT PER BANK in SETTINGS gives the 16 patterns of a bank the kit of its first pattern (A01 for A01 to A16), like the Octatrack's parts. Off at power-on.
Hold PTN and press YES to lock the active pattern to its own copy of the sound; again to share the bank's kit. The switch and the locks are saved with the project.
Pasting a pattern never overwrites its bank's sound. Old projects open with the switch off and play as on the stock OS.
Known issue: for under a second after PTN+YES, a knob turn can be ignored while the kit reloads.
